WITH stats AS ( 
    SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) AS avg_reaction, 
           (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) AS range 
    FROM measurements 
) 
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS 
SELECT * FROM measurements 
WHERE reaction_ms BETWEEN 
    (SELECT avg_reaction - 3 * range FROM stats) AND 
    (SELECT avg_reaction + 3 * range FROM stats);
